### 2026-10-18 – i realized mid-way through checking my files that i had completely forgotten to export the step files for the project. i went back into onshape and re-exported every single part and assembly file in s

**1h**

i realized mid-way through checking my files that i had completely forgotten to export the step files for the project. i went back into onshape and re-exported every single part and assembly file in step format so anyone can actually edit them. after fixing that mistake, i wrote up the entire project readme and captured a few crisp renders and screenshots to drop straight into the documentation. i finished everything off by uploading all the newly organized files to the github repo and recording both the idea reel and the 5-hour update reel [recording video reels while completely exhausted is a special kind of endurance test, but at least week 2 CAD design is officially wrapped up].
